raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students and Others (Component I - Class IX & X)
Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10
Academic Requirement: Regular student studying in Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school.
School Type Requirement: Government schools, schools run by local bodies, or recognized private schools.
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 250000
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance: Academic allowance of ₹3,500/year (Day Scholar) to ₹7,000/year (Hosteller) plus 10% disability allowance if applicable. - Rs. 4000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students and Others (Component I - Class IX & X)?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility_summary.academic_requirement: Regular student studying in Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school.
eligibility_summary.school_type_requirement: Government schools, schools run by local bodies, or recognized private schools.

benefits_summary.details: Academic allowance of ₹3,500/year (Day Scholar) to ₹7,000/year (Hosteller) plus 10% disability allowance if applicable.

raw.inclusion_rationale: Centrally sponsored scheme designed to curb dropout rates at the secondary level for SC students transitioning into Class 9 & 10.
